title: Team
create.title: Add an account
create.explain: The new account has no rights at first: give it some on its page.
create.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. The person can change it later.
account.resetNote: This ends all the sessions of the account.
grants.title: Rights
grants.addExplain: You can only give rights you hold yourself, for a scope and a duration you also hold.
serviceHint: A service account: an identity for a tool, with keys and no password.
subtitle: {{count}} account(s). Open one to manage its rights.
account.disableTip: The person can no longer sign in. Their data is kept.
account.disableConfirm: Disable the account {{name}}? They will be signed out and unable to log in.
account.resetTwofaTip: Use this when the person lost their phone and their backup codes.
account.resetTwofaConfirm: Remove the second factor of {{name}}? Their account will only be protected by the password until they set it up again.
grants.removeConfirm: Remove the right {{right}} from this account?
grants.scopeTip: Everywhere, or on one node only. A narrow scope is safer.
grants.expiresTip: Optional. The right disappears by itself at that date: handy for a one-off helper.
grants.tip: A right lets this account do one precise thing. Prefer roles for everyday use; use single rights for exceptions.
